meta.name: Shafted 2025
meta.description: Four middle-aged male friends fumble their way through love, life and career crises in modern-day Paris — when did being a man become so hard?

videos.title: Maleficent
videos.overview: Each dealing with their own personal crisis, best friends Cédric, Tom, Tonio and Jérem channel their rage at the world into a vengeful act of vandalism.

videos.title: Mr. Misunderstood
videos.overview: As Cédric scrambles to find a new job, Tom tries online dating. Jérem and Cécile attend sex therapy, while Tonio and Delphine try out a swingers club.

videos.title: From Bad to Worse
videos.overview: Jérem feels invigorated while Cécile flounders. Cédric's first day on the job doesn't go as planned and Léna embarks on a new venture as an influencer.

videos.title: Cavemen
videos.overview: The guys' luxury ski weekend takes a disastrous turn off the beaten track. Meanwhile, Léna and Magda bond as things heat up between Cécile and Jordan.

videos.title: The Worst of Times
videos.overview: Tom upsets Camille as Cédric launches his own workshop. Delphine jumps at the chance of a new life in Madrid and Jérem makes life miserable for Jordan.

videos.title: Heartbreak
videos.overview: Delphine and Tonio throw a Spanish-themed going-away party at the restaurant. What starts out as fun turns into a night of revelations for everyone.
